abf6e39d.text:
You dial yourself up every morning.

The switch says: what is that hum?

I’m calling for myself. The humming is not my own,

e7c7f50b.text: It's something in the world. I can't turn it off.

d392c0b6.text: I try to keep the humming from getting me down.

05544422.text: I'm alone. I can feel it.

2f757757.text: There are no more people in this place.

f7e9368e.text: There is nothing left here but hums

c233ef03.text: of life, hums of things that were once alive

eca0632a.text: that I have forgotten to kill and are now dead

9e8de601.text: that I have left behind that I've never learned to hate,

95f0d678.text: What am I going to do about this humming?

dc0e1ec7.text: There isn't anything that I can do.

d6f2fa06.text: I hear only the hum of my thoughts

accbcbc2.text: which, to me, is not so much a voice as an echo.

de13445a.text: The sound of a mind humming and echoing itself,

a2e5c111.text: A mind humming and echoing itself.

d75b2ea2.text: I hear only my mind's hum.
